parts.title: Objects with a story
questions: Do you keep objects that remind you of a particular event?
What kinds of objects do people in your family pass on?
Do you enjoy visiting exhibitions about ordinary life?
How do you decide whether an old object is worth keeping?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe an ordinary object that could tell someone about a period in your life.
questions: Say what the object is and where it came from.
Explain what someone might learn from it.
Say what they would need to know to understand its significance.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: Why might museums collect ordinary objects alongside rare ones?
What can be lost when an object is seen only in a digital photograph?
How can an exhibition make an uncertain interpretation clear to visitors?
Whose stories are hardest to preserve through objects?
